cohort: The study included 318 postpartum mothers at the Tamale Teaching Hospital.
finding: The prevalence of caesarean section was 8.8%, and significant factors influencing it were maternal age above 30 years, rural settlement, twin delivery, and obstetric complications.
mod_finding: Maternal age above 30 years, twin delivery, and obstetric complications were positively associated with caesarean section, while rural settlement was negatively associated.
